title: Write 2 · 里 出 些 起 别 回 样 女 在 不 就 个 和 说 要
focus: 里 出 些 起 别 回 样 女 在 不 就 个 和 说 要
body:
Repeating parts: 口 (别, 回, 和, 说), 女 (女, 要), 走 in 起, and 讠 speech in 说.

## Rules that matter here
- **Close the box last**: 回 = outer frame, inner 口, then the bottom stroke.
- **Horizontal vs ノ first**: 在 writes 一 before ノ (like 左); 有 writes ノ first (like 右).
- In 个, the vertical in the middle is written after 人.

cards.Notes: 田-like top + 土 = 7 strokes: 丨, 横折, 一, 一, the vertical runs down through, then 一, long 一 last. Lookalike: 理 (王 + 里).
Two stacked 凵 shapes on one long vertical = 5 strokes. Top part first: 竖折, the long middle 丨, the short right 丨; then bottom 竖折 and right 丨.
此 this (6: 止 + 匕) on top + 二 (2) = 8 strokes. Top before bottom; the bottom horizontal is the longest.
走 walk (7) + 己 self (3, phonetic jǐ) = 10 strokes. 走 first, then 己. Lookalike: 己 jǐ vs 已 yǐ vs 巳 sì.
另 (口 3 + 力-like 2) + 刂 knife (2) = 7 strokes. Left before right; 刂: short vertical, then the long vertical hook.
Big 口 around small 口 = 6 strokes. Outside before inside, close the box last: 丨, 横折, inner 口 (3), then bottom 一.
木 tree (4) + 羊 sheep (6, phonetic yáng) = 10 strokes. In 木 on the left, ㇏ shrinks to a dot. 羊's vertical is last.
3 strokes: く (撇点), then ノ, then the horizontal last. As a left radical (好, 她) the horizontal becomes a rising stroke.
一 and ノ (2) + 丨 + 土 earth (3) = 6 strokes. Here the horizontal comes BEFORE ノ (like 左), unlike 有. Lookalike: 再 zài 'again'.
4 strokes: 一, ノ, 丨, dot. (bù; becomes bú before tone 4.) Lookalike: 还 contains 不 + 辶.
京 capital (8) + 尤 (4) = 12 strokes. Left before right; in 尤 write 一, ノ, 乚, then the dot last.
人 (2) + 丨 (1) = 3 strokes. ノ, ㇏, then the vertical down the middle. Usually toneless ge as a measure word.

cards.Prompt: 我＿你 · wǒ hé nǐ · you and me
cards.Notes: 禾 grain (5) + 口 mouth (3, phonetic-ish) = 8 strokes. 禾: ノ, 一, 丨, ノ, dot. Lookalike: 知 (矢 + 口).
讠 speech (2) + 兑 (7: 丷 + 口 + 儿) = 9 strokes. Left before right; 讠 is dot, then ㇊ fold.
覀 (6) on top + 女 woman (3) = 9 strokes. 覀: 一, 丨, 横折, two inner 丨, bottom 一; then 女.
